start: as a main track AFTER (1) the controlled re-export is ingested and (2) the first unseen-villa CAD blind run is frozen and compared - target R8.22
principle: PDF / schedule / note / section / elevation evidence feeds the SAME SOURCE -> OBSERVATION -> CLAIM -> EVIDENCE -> GEOMETRY -> TRADE -> QTO pipeline; no second BOQ calculator

stages.what: sections / elevations: clear and finish heights as WALL_HEIGHT_AUTHORITY rank 1-2 candidates (replaces owner height facts where the drawings state them)
door / window schedules: opening heights and sills as source facts (replaces QP-21 / QP-22 owner parameters where scheduled)
finish schedules / notes: trade rules per room class as source claims
PDF-only plans with CONFIRMED scale as a geometry route (cross-route to CAD)

donor_mechanisms: OpenTakeoff: scale must be confirmed before any quantity; mixed scale blocks; schedule rows never dropped silently
never: a PDF quantity that bypasses the claim / evidence layer
OCR text as authority without its source anchor
